name: Jesse Gause
dateNote: Joseph Smith chose him as counselor on 8 March 1832, and section 81 was first addressed to him on 15 March.
importance: Jesse Gause was a former Quaker and Shaker whom Joseph Smith chose as a counselor on 8 March 1832. The revelation now in section 81 was first written to him, then readdressed to Frederick G. Williams. He went with Joseph to Missouri in spring 1832 and is listed in the United Firm. He left a mission in August 1832 and was apparently excommunicated that December.
connections: He served with Sidney Rigdon and travelled with Zebedee Coltrin on his 1832 mission.

sources.title: Jesse Gause, Joseph Smith Papers biography
